title: Boot & front door: process start -> title verified -> New Game chosen
_comment: Transcribed from ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section B (span), section G (GF-01-TITLE-01) and section H (S01 is one of the mandatory 0.5 Hz continuous-evidence segments). No teleport: section 0.6, production paths only.
_comment_no_handoff: Section B gives S01 the entry save 'none (fresh)' and the handoff 'in-memory (no save yet exists pre-starter)'. So this file deliberately ends WITHOUT a Save-tab save and without save_out -- it is the one journey segment that hands nothing to the next one on disk.

steps.title: Section H cadence for this segment

args.text: Section H makes S01 one of the segments that must be recorded continuously: 'PNG every 2 s (0.5 Hz) plus a forced frame on every JSONL event'. The step vocabulary in tools/gate_f/SEGMENT_SCHEMA.md has no background-recorder action -- `capture_seq` is a bounded, blocking run of frames, not a recorder that runs while other steps play. This note records the section H requirement against this segment and the gap; the harness's event-forced frames and the 2 Hz route trace are what actually run continuously here.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl

steps.title: start from a fresh user:// save directory
steps.expected: Section A.2 records `save_state` as 'fresh user:// dir'. With no save present the title's Start New Game goes straight into the world instead of raising `title_screen.gd`'s overwrite confirmation, so this is also what makes the front-door path deterministic

steps.title: boot the real title screen
steps.expected: Section I.4: 'process start -> title interactive' is measured. The real title scene comes up with the real autoloads and Start New Game focused

steps.title: the title screen owns input
steps.expected: input_context is 'title'. Section 0.6 production paths only: this is the front door a player meets, not a world scene booted past it

steps.title: something holds GUI focus on the title
steps.expected: a Control holds focus. Section E.4's own standard: without one the stick moves nothing and the front door is decoration on a handheld

steps.title: capture GF-01-TITLE-01

args.intended_proof: front door is a real game's front door; save slots legible

steps.expected: Section G: title screen fully loaded, S01 -- front door is a real game's front door; save slots legible

steps.title: front-door observation (section G GF-01-TITLE-01)

args.text: Section E.5 has no objective here -- there is no tracked objective before the world exists -- so this is the front-door record section G-01 asks for instead: what the title actually offers a first-time player, whether the save slots are legible, and whether Load Game reads as available or disabled on a fresh install. Reasoned from GF-01-TITLE-01.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl

steps.title: choose Start New Game
steps.expected: Section B: S01's span ends at 'title verified, New Game chosen'. Start New Game is focused, and with no existing save `title_screen.gd::_on_new_pressed` starts the game directly rather than asking to confirm an overwrite

steps.title: let the world stand up from New Game
steps.expected: Section I.4: 'title -> world playable' is measured. A cold Meadows stand-up costs about 90 s of CPU on this container -- 466k scattered props and a terrain build

steps.title: the new game starts in the village region
steps.expected: map_state.gd's own containment puts the fresh spawn in `grandpas_village` -- the opening starts inside Grandpa's farmhouse (docs/OPENING_SEQUENCE.md beat 1)

steps.title: a new game starts with no creatures
steps.expected: the belt is empty until beat 4's starter choice, which is S02's subject

steps.title: the first tracked objective is the chain's first rung
steps.expected: Section E.5 tracks 24 main-chain objectives from `opening_first_catch`; the quest log tracks the first main entry whose flag is not set, so a fresh game tracks that one

steps.title: the 2 Hz trace ran
steps.expected: Section C.2: route.csv is the pacing study's raw material and the section 12 correlation spine. Even a segment that never walks must produce a trace

steps.title: close the segment

args.text: Section B: S01's handoff is 'in-memory (no save yet exists pre-starter)'. This segment therefore ends with no Save-tab save and no save_out. AMBIGUITY, recorded rather than papered over: section B also gives S02 the entry save 'continues S01 process', but tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh runs one segment per Godot process, so S02 cannot continue this process. S02 reproduces this exact state through the same production front door instead, and says so in its own first step.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl
